optimizedDescription.value: Defines backend-neutral atomic graph persistence for nodes, semantic facts, search, impact, freshness, and recoverable generations.

optimizedContext.value:
# Graph Store

## Rules
- Abstract `GraphStore(storagePath)` port in `domain/ports/`; adapters in `infrastructure/`. Backends own physical schema; consumers use abstract semantics.
- Persist full-content `FileNode`, `SymbolNode`, `SpecNode`, `DocumentNode`; relations `IMPORTS`, `DEFINES`, `CALLS`, `CONSTRUCTS`, `USES_TYPE`, `EXPORTS`, `DEPENDS_ON`, `COVERS_FILE`, `COVERS_SYMBOL`, `EXTENDS`, `IMPLEMENTS`, `OVERRIDES`; metadata `lastIndexedAt`, `lastIndexedRef`, graph fingerprint.
- `open()` never clears/recreates; unsafe corruption/incompatibility → typed recoverable open error. `close()` idempotent after success/partial failure. Closed-only `recreate()` physically replaces storage, rotates generation, remains closed. Open healthy `clear()` removes all logically influential nodes, facts, observations, latches, fingerprints, refs, coverage and search entries while preserving generation.
- Persist generation marker under storage root; provider caches at open and checks before reads.
- `upsertFile(file, symbols, relations)` atomically replaces file-owned symbols/relations; `addRelations` additive for cross-file facts; `removeFile` atomically removes file, symbols and endpoint relations. `upsertSpec` atomically replaces source `DEPENDS_ON`; `removeSpec` removes node and source/target dependencies.
- Closed operation → `StoreNotOpenError`.
- Provide single and deterministic batched reads for files, documents, symbols, specs and incoming/outgoing symbol relations. Batch inputs deduped; missing omitted; first-request identity order; relations source/type/target order; empty input avoids work; no one-call-per-item implementation.
- Query callers/callees, imports, hierarchy, implementation, override, spec dependencies, file/symbol coverage. `findSymbols(SymbolQuery)` supports name, kinds, filePath, comment, case sensitivity.
- Filtered impact applies type/kind/workspace inclusion/exclusion physically before return; exclusions win; empty inclusion admits all; `resource` identifies expanded/hydrated category; depth zero supports direct coverage. Never widen in worker/batch protocols or filter unrestricted candidates in TypeScript.
- Statistics expose file/symbol/spec counts, every relation count, languages, indexing timestamp/ref, fingerprint.
- Search symbols/specs/documents plus `rebuildFtsIndexes()`. Return snippets with 1-based lines. Rank exact canonical identity, exact primary/alternate name, structured component, then prefix/suffix/substring identity ahead of generic body/comment frequency. Shared lexical expansion preserves token and splits whitespace, `: / _ . -`, CamelCase/PascalCase. Apply all filters before limit; generic BM25-equivalent retrieval remains.
- Persist logical symbols, declarations, bindings/provenance, symbol spaces, public/local surfaces, per-file/package coverage, reference facts. Structured indexed lookups; canonical IDs remain unique external identities but never parsed/case-folded/substring-searched for resolution or semantic ranking. Distinct bindings/routes remain distinct.
- Member semantics use structured equality axes: workspace, surface, simple name, symbol space, owner id, `MemberSemantics` (`kind`, `dispatch`, `accessor`, optional `nativeKind`). No parallel `memberForm`, serialized-ID parsing, alias table, or FTS lookup. Owned logical symbols persist `qualified_name`; equality lookup returns every match. Public bindings remain addressable by surface/exported name/symbol space/target even across workspaces.
- Persist deterministic complete reference snapshot and batched directly affected files across import/call/construct/type-use/extend/implement/override. Indexer retains unaffected facts and expands closure without per-symbol/relation calls.
- `COVERS_SYMBOL` targets current logical symbol ID, never declaration occurrence. Validate committed spec source/logical target; bulk persist, reverse indexes, stats and queries preserve target ID. Reverse coverage batches full deduped file/symbol blast radius.
- Source-content candidate query uses persisted `FileNode.content`, normalized full query, raw/expanded terms, category limit, filters/exclusions/snippet preference. Return bounded candidates with relevance and occurrence evidence; substring index for >=3 chars, bounded shorter fallback. Application owns verification, provenance, suppression, final rank/group/limit.
- Incompatible schema rejects reads; authorized index repair performs destructive rebuild, rotates generation, rebuilds all indexes before readable. No incremental migration required for derived cache.
- Persist `IndexedInputObservation` separately: workspace, logical kind/id, input kind, non-absolute locator, content hash, optional mtime/size/revision, monotonic stale. Aggregate specs observe every content/metadata/state input. Batch CAS prevents pre-reindex assessment mutating new evidence. Per-workspace and global `knownStaleSinceLastIndex` latches clear only after successful indexing; transient unknown never stale.
- Bulk indexing session begins once, accepts bounded node/fact/observation/relation chunks, commits once, rebuilds semantic/source indexes once. Batch endpoint/hierarchy lookup; dedup relations; failure exposes no partial generation.
- `clear()`, `getAllFiles()`, `getAllSpecs()` support incremental/full indexing.

## Constraints
- Abstract class, not interface; no `@specd/core` dependency; errors extend `CodeGraphError`.
- Mutations atomic; no partial updates.
- No prescribed backend, physical schema, or filesystem layout.
- Destructive reset only through provider/index-owned `recreate()`, never caller file deletion.
- Generation marker enables cross-process stale detection.
